meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证程序缺陷并修复,自动以 PR 或 issue 形式提交到正确仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你修好了某个工具的 Bug,却不确定该提 PR 还是开 issue。
copy.tagline_en: Verify and fix a defect, then submit it as the right pull request or issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you fixed a bug but aren't sure whether to open a PR or an issue.

howto.what: Claude 会先复现你报的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷,在临时工作区写最小修复并跑通验证,然后按归属交付:上游 openai/codex 提 fork PR,LazyCodex 自身缺陷提内嵌补丁的 issue(不开 PR)。
howto.when: 当你要求修复某个 bug、为 bug 提 PR,或调试并提交 LazyCodex / Codex 缺陷时触发。它会先比较两个源码仓库来判定归属。

say.text: 帮我修一下这个 LazyCodex 崩溃的 bug
这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 帮我开个 PR
say.note: 会 fork openai/codex、推分支并创建 PR

say.text: 把这个 bug 的复现和补丁写成一个 issue
say.note: issue 正文会内嵌 unified diff 补丁

howto.what_en: Claude reproduces your LazyCodex or Codex defect, writes the smallest fix in a temp workspace, verifies it, then delivers: a fork PR for upstream openai/codex, or a verified-fix issue with the embedded patch for LazyCodex-owned bugs (never a PR there).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect. It syncs and compares both source repos to route ownership.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex crash bug for me
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then opens a verified-fix issue

say_en.text: Open a PR for this Codex CLI bug
say_en.note: Forks openai/codex, pushes a branch, creates the PR

say_en.text: Write up this bug's repro and patch as an issue
say_en.note: Issue body embeds the unified diff patch
